title: Circuit Similarity Map
description: Interactive 2D visualization showing electrical circuits organized by content similarity using dimensionality reduction on circuit embeddings
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Circuit Analysis
Data Visualization
Machine Learning
Dimensionality Reduction
Circuit Classification
learningObjectives: Explain how a circuit embedding turns a circuit's description into a vector, and how dimensionality reduction projects those vectors onto a 2D map where distance approximates similarity
Interpret the scatter plot by changing the Color By and Size By dropdowns to map category, circuit type, complexity, and component count onto visual channels
Identify clusters of related circuits and explain what shared characteristics place a voltage divider and an LED circuit near each other
Compare average complexity and component count across circuit categories using the category filter and Min Components slider
Evaluate the limits of a 2D projection, including why two circuits far apart in the original embedding space can appear close on the map
